tree.loadFailedUnknown: The request failed. This is not the same as having no agents.

scope.emptyUser: No agents of your own yet — create one with + above.
scope.emptyOrg: Nothing shared in this organization yet.
scope.emptyOrgNoTeam: Join a team to share agents with an organization.

detail.selectAgent: Select an agent, job, or intent on the left
detail.emptyHint: Built-in agents are read-only — create an agent of your own with the + button on the left.

agentDef.title: Agent definition
agentDef.desc: Identity and shared MCP servers for every job of this agent (agent.yaml).
agentDef.name: Display name
agentDef.mcpHint: env and header values are plain text, or a credential reference (lock toggle) resolved from the encrypted per-user store when the server starts — secrets never live in the definition file.
agentDef.mcpCredentialsHint: Keys referenced by the servers above. Values are stored encrypted per user and never shown again.
agentDef.mcpCredUnreferencedHint: Not referenced by any server in this definition. You can still remove it.
agentDef.idHint: The id is the definition directory name. Changing it moves the directory and every session and plan folder keyed by it, across all of your workspaces.
agentDef.idInvalid: Ids are lowercase kebab-case: a-z, 0-9 and single hyphens between them.
agentDef.idYamlDrift: The id in the YAML view no longer matches the directory — saving would be refused. Undo it there and use Apply instead.
agentDef.idDirtyBlocked: Save or discard your pending changes first — the move reloads this file.

overview.yamlParseError: YAML syntax error — the form is disabled and saving is blocked
overview.jobDefinitionDesc: This job’s name and builtin allowlist — the tool list validates directly against the universal preset, and each tool carries its own approval policy. Selecting everything omits the key (full preset). MCP servers live in the YAML view.
overview.jobIdHint: The id is the job directory name. Changing it moves the directory and this job’s session and plan folders, across all of your workspaces.
overview.toolsHint: Click a name to include or exclude the tool; click its state segment to override approval. Mutating tools default to 'always' (call rejected until approved), everything else to 'never'.
overview.toolIncluded: In the allowlist — click to exclude
overview.toolExcluded: Excluded from the allowlist — click to include
overview.approvalDefaultDesc: Declare nothing and follow the inherited policy
overview.approvalAskDesc: Ask the user right before the call
overview.intentsHint: Situations this job declares — each intent lives in its own folder under intents/ (infer.md + optional prompt.md and hooks.yaml). Open one to edit its criterion, prompt, and hooks; the agent reads the catalog on every turn.
overview.intentsEmpty: No intents — every turn runs on the base prompts alone.
overview.intentInfer: When does this intent apply? (rendered verbatim as a catalog entry)
overview.fixIntents: Fix the intent catalog issues before saving.
overview.fixMcp: Fix the MCP server issues before saving.
overview.fixYaml: Fix the YAML syntax error before saving.
overview.inferParseError: Frontmatter error — the form is disabled and saving is blocked

intent.identityDesc: This intent is the directory jobs/{{jobId}}/intents/{{intentId}}/ — its id is that name. The files inside it are the cards below.
intent.criteriaDesc: Prose describing when this intent applies — the agent reads it verbatim in its Intent Catalog every turn, and it is what an @intent: mention selects. The Raw view shows the file with its optional clarify frontmatter.
intent.idHint: The id is the intent directory name (intents/{id}/). Changing it moves the directory; @intent: mentions already sent keep referring to the old id.
intent.idTaken: This job already has an intent with that id.
intent.notFound: This intent no longer exists in the catalog.
intent.hooksCardDesc: The completion contract verified when the turn stops (the stop event) — from actual tool results, never the model's claims. Stored in this intent's hooks.yaml; an empty list deletes the file.
intent.clarifyHint: Autonomous turns never ask a blocking question and proceed with sensible defaults.
intent.hooksNone: No hooks — the turn ends when the agent stops.
intent.hooksHint: Every entry must hold when the turn stops — the stop event — verified from actual tool results (AND), never from the model's claims. An artifact glob must match a real file write this turn; an action names a tool that must have been successfully called. Unmet hooks re-prompt the agent a bounded number of times, then pause the job resumably.
intent.phantomHint: New intent — nothing is on disk yet. Author the matching criteria and Save to create intents/{{id}}/.
intent.globDirHint: One field for the whole path — nest it with "/" (reports/weekly/kr).
intent.globStarHint: * matches any characters within one path segment
intent.globGlobstarHint: ** matches any depth — valid only as a whole segment
intent.globPreviewAnyFile: Any file written anywhere in the artifact folder.
intent.globFileEndsWith: a file whose name ends with "{{suffix}}"
intent.globFileStartsWith: a file whose name starts with "{{prefix}}"
intent.actionPickerPlaceholder: Pick the tool this turn must call…
intent.hintActionNotInBuiltin: '{{tool}}' is not in this job's tools.builtin — the hook could never be met. Add the tool to the job or pick another.
intent.hintMcpServerUnknown: No MCP server "{{server}}" is declared on this job or agent — the hook could never be met.
intent.hintActionUnknownTool: '{{tool}}' is not a universal builtin tool — saving will be refused unless it is a full mcp__{server}__{tool} name.
intent.hintArtifactNoWriter: This job's tool list has no file-writing tool (create_file / edit_file / append_file / copy_file) — an artifact hook could never be met.
intent.promptDesc: Prose added to the system prompt while this intent is active. Leave empty to keep none — an emptied file is deleted on save.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.agentDescription: EVERY file under base/ is added to the system prompt on every turn — inherited by all of this agent's jobs.
prompts.jobDescription: EVERY file under this job's base/ is added to the system prompt on every turn, after the agent's own.
prompts.empty: No prompt files in this scope yet.
prompts.validationWarnings: Saved with warnings — affected jobs will fail to load until fixed:

promote.title: Promote to organization
promote.desc: Share this agent with your whole organization. It moves out of your personal scope; every member can see and run it, and you remain its owner.
promote.confirmMessage: Promote "{{name}}" to your organization? The agent moves out of your personal scope — every member can then see and run it, and you stay its owner.

orgAccess.title: Organization access
orgAccess.desc: Every member can see and run this agent. Editing is limited to the owner, org admins, and the editors you delegate here.
orgAccess.noMembers: No other members in this organization yet.

danger.agentDesc: Removes the whole agent directory, every job included. This cannot be undone.
danger.jobDesc: Removes the job directory (definition files included). The session history of past runs is not touched.
danger.intentDesc: Removes the intent directory (infer.md, prompt.md, hooks.yaml). An unsaved intent just drops its draft.

import.badFolderName: Upload exactly one folder whose name is the id ([a-z0-9-]).
import.missingJobYaml: The job folder must contain job.yaml at its root.
import.missingInferMd: The intent folder must contain infer.md at its root.
import.conflictReadonly: Agent id "{{id}}" is taken by a read-only agent — rename the folder.
import.replaceMessage: This directory already exists. Overwriting REPLACES its definition files — anything not in the upload is removed.
import.replaceAgentMessage: An agent with this id already exists. Overwriting REPLACES its definition files; past session data is left untouched.
